caption: The drawing is a monochromatic, hand-sketched architectural illustration of a structure labeled "STREET GATE." The gate structure consists of two vertical brick columns supporting a prominent horizontal entablature at the top, which features decorative moldings. The entryway is fitted with two hinged iron gates, each adorned with vertical bars, pointed finials on top, and ornamental scrollwork in the upper and middle sections. Above the gates, within the frame of the entablature, is a horizontal panel of intricate wrought iron with repeating scroll patterns. The surface below the gate appears to be paved. There is stippling and cross-hatching in the background to indicate walls or shrubbery, and a horizontal measurement labeled "90°" is marked at ground level between the gateposts. The drawing is rendered in black ink on a light tan paper background, with all lines and text in the same color.
title: Wrought and Cast Iron Gate
